file_stem: RWB E1 040 Document checklist per case type as reference data
title: Document checklist per case type as reference data
goal: Required documents per stage and route as versioned data, so missing ones show on the case
why: Litigation packs stop failing for a missing title deed. The checklist is recomputed when a document arrives, the stage changes, or a version takes effect.
triggers: JOB-12 checklistRefreshStep on a new version
ace_note: No ACE read. Stage and route come from the Workbench case; documents from the document hub.

writes.note: required types per stage and route (CHK-2026.11)
present / missing per case and type

rules: BR2: case type = stage; rows for the route take precedence over rows with no route
BR3: a version takes effect on valid_from, no deployment
BR4: only active documents count, once per type
BR6: a repeated event changes nothing
risks: No rows for the stage -> 'No checklist for this case type'
Bad type or stage in the load -> refused (MSG-P3-027)
example: RW-2026-000123 at stage LITIGATION holds a demand letter and a court notice
